about: Product-specific VST3 component floats, measured from public host APIs. Values are stored VST3 plain values, which need not equal displayed physical units. Component and controller envelopes, unknown float slots and private tails are retained.

layers: stored float32 controls and opaque tail

parameters/Style.about: VST3 parameter 1. Host display: 0 = Transparent; 2 = Dynamic; 4 = Aggressive; 5 = Modern; 7 = Safe.

parameters/Attack.about: VST3 parameter 3. Host display: 0 = 0.000 ms; 0.25 = 39.06 ms; 0.5 = 625.0 ms; 0.75 = 3.164 sec; 1 = 10.00 sec.

parameters/Release.about: VST3 parameter 4. Host display: 0 = 0.000 ms; 0.25 = 107.2 ms; 0.5 = 857.3 ms; 0.75 = 2.894 sec; 1 = 10.00 sec.

parameters/Channel Link Center.about: VST3 parameter 7. Host display: 0 = Excluded; 0 = Excluded; 1 = Included; 1 = Included; 1 = Included.

parameters/Channel Link LFE.about: VST3 parameter 8. Host display: 0 = Excluded; 0 = Excluded; 1 = Included; 1 = Included; 1 = Included.

parameters/True Peak Limiting.about: VST3 parameter 10. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Dithering.about: VST3 parameter 11. Host display: 0 = Off; 1 = 16 Bits; 3 = 20 Bits; 4 = 22 Bits; 5 = 24 Bits.

parameters/Noise Shaping.about: VST3 parameter 12. Host display: 0 = None; 1 = Basic; 2 = Optimized; 2 = Optimized; 3 = Weighted.

parameters/Filter DC Offset.about: VST3 parameter 13. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Side Chain Triggering.about: VST3 parameter 14. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Unity Gain.about: VST3 parameter 15. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Audition Limiting.about: VST3 parameter 16. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Bypass.about: VST3 parameter 17. Host display: 0 = Not Bypassed; 0 = Not Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed.

parameters/Output Level.about: VST3 parameter 18. Host display: -30 = -30.00 dBTP; -22.5 = -22.50 dBTP; -15 = -15.00 dBTP; -7.5 = -7.50 dBTP; 0 = 0.00 dBTP.

parameters/Lock Output.about: VST3 parameter 19. Host display: 0 = Unlocked; 0 = Unlocked; 1 = Locked; 1 = Locked; 1 = Locked.

parameters/Receive Midi.about: VST3 parameter 20. Host display: 0 = Enabled; 0 = Enabled; 1 = Disabled; 1 = Disabled; 1 = Disabled.

parameters/Show Advanced.about: VST3 parameter 21. Host display: 0 = Hide; 0 = Hide; 1 = Show; 1 = Show; 1 = Show.

parameters/True Peak Metering.about: VST3 parameter 22. Host display: 0 = Show Sample Peaks; 0 = Show Sample Peaks; 1 = Show True Peaks; 1 = Show True Peaks; 1 = Show True Peaks.

parameters/Display Mode.about: VST3 parameter 23. Host display: 0 = Slow Down; 1 = Fast; 2 = Slow; 3 = Infinite; 4 = Off.

parameters/Meter Scale.about: VST3 parameter 24. Host display: 0 = -16 dB; 2 = -48 dB; 3 = K-12; 5 = K-20; 6 = Loudness.

parameters/Loudness Time Scale.about: VST3 parameter 25. Host display: 0 = Momentary; 1 = Short Term; 1 = Short Term; 2 = Integrated; 2 = Integrated.

parameters/Loudness Meter Scale.about: VST3 parameter 26. Host display: 0 = Target +9; 0 = Target +9; 1 = Target +18; 1 = Target +18; 1 = Target +18.

parameters/Loudness Meter Origin.about: VST3 parameter 27. Host display: 0 = Absolute; 0 = Absolute; 1 = Relative; 1 = Relative; 1 = Relative.

parameters/Loudness Integrated Peak Time.about: VST3 parameter 29. Host display: 0 = Max Momentary; 0 = Max Momentary; 1 = Max Short Term; 1 = Max Short Term; 1 = Max Short Term.

parameters/Loudness Recording.about: VST3 parameter 30. Host display: 0 = Paused; 0 = Paused; 1 = Recording; 1 = Recording; 1 = Recording.

parameters/Loudness Auto-Reset.about: VST3 parameter 31. Host display: 0 = Disabled; 0 = Disabled; 1 = Enabled; 1 = Enabled; 1 = Enabled.
